verified.value: Merged with three merger fixes on top of lane-b's two (partial-fill denominator: slippage and fee now scaled by filled/target before summing; _resolve_date parses the offset and takes the UTC date). Merger: (1) the test harness could never fail under pytest - check() only appended to a list and every test returned None; it now raises, with a test proving it goes red; (2) a day without a paper NAV now has weighted_gap_bps = None instead of 0.0, and the weekly mean averages only measured days; (3) the weekly cumulative figure used the Monday NAV from a dict that holds event days only, so a quiet Monday silently gave 0 bps; it now uses the earliest paper NAV in the ISO week (paper_nav passed in, else the event days), None when the week has none. 20 tests; test_reconcile.py registered in preflight.

notes:
2026-10-18 lane-b 交付。src/data/execution/reconcile.py:纯函数(无 IO),封装 fill_log.py 的 slippage/opportunity 原语;新增 fee_bps / per_trade_gap / daily_tracking_error / weekly_summary;每笔实施缺口 = slippage_bps + fee_bps + opportunity_bps(每个 None 而非 0,缺即不可比);以 target_notional 而非 filled_notional 计价未填部分(避免 fills-only 偏差);日 TE 分母用 paper NAV 而非 live NAV(live NAV 已吸收缺口本身);日 TE 不为零填无事件的日子(无事件 = 未测);周用 ISO 校准。tests/test_reconcile.py:13 项全绿(单点 5bps fee + 10bps slip + 0opp 的 filled taker → 15bps gap / 0.15% × 5000 = $7.5 实施成本 USD;partial fill 100bps opp × 50% 未填 = 50bps 单边,三种成分并存;expired 时 slip / fee 为 None,opp 单算 = 100bps;sell side 卖出 bid 同为 COST;maker 内部成交 slip 为负 / fee 仍正;两日同 ISO 归为同一周,跨周分开;空对空 → 空字典)。fill_log_records_the_misses 不动。
2026-10-18 lane-b 修订(Seth 退回):两处分母 / 时区 bug。① 部分成交:slippage_bps / fee_bps 是「已成交名义额」的 bp,opportunity_bps 已是「目标名义额」的 bp,implementation_gap_bps 把三者直接相加再乘 target_notional/1e4 ⇒ 部分成交时滑点和手续费被放大 target/filled 倍。改成把 slippage 和 fee 各乘 filled/target 后再与 opportunity 相加,统一以目标名义额为分母。Seth 指定验:50% 成交、10bp 滑点、5bp 手续费、100bp 机会 ⇒ 缺口 = 5 + 2.5 + 50 = 57.5bp(测试 test_per_trade_gap_partial_fill_denominator_demonstrated 钉住)。② _resolve_date 用 ts_resolved[:10],带 +09:00 等时区的字符串落错日;改为 datetime.fromisoformat → 转 UTC → 取日期,无时区按 UTC(测试 test_resolve_date_offset_bearing_iso8601_lands_on_utc_date:Seth 指定 2026-10-18T08:00:00+09:00 ⇒ 2026-10-17)。测试 17/17 过(13 旧 + 2 denominator + 2 timezone)。其余不动。状态 in_review,推 lane-b/T-124。
2026-10-18 Seth 合并:lane-b 交了分母与 UTC 两处;§Seth-1018b 的 1–3(测试不会红、缺 NAV 记 0、周起点取不到记 0)由合并方补上,见 verified。
